events.subtitle: WPFW 50th-year benefit — Two Bass Hit
events.factual_description: WPFW 89.3 FM presents its fourth 50th-year benefit concert, An Afternoon of Jazz & Justice: Two Bass Hit, on Sunday, September 13, 2026 from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM at Palisades Hub, 5200 Cathedral Avenue NW in Washington, DC. WPFW describes the program as a tip of the hat to bassist Ray Brown and pairs Washington bassist Herman Burney with trombonist Reginald Cyntje while Baltimore bassist Kris Funn brings back his DC JazzPrix-winning group CornerStore. WPFW lists general admission at $35, a two-ticket bundle at $50, and student admission at $20 with valid ID. The primary page links directly to an authorized Eventbrite ticket destination. Individual CornerStore personnel beyond Funn are not identified on the event page and are not inferred.

enrichment.note: The primary WPFW event page verifies the exact date, time, venue, billing, Ray Brown framing, ticket prices and authorized Eventbrite destination. It does not identify every CornerStore member, and no exact Apple Music preparation link was verified in this pass, so those components remain pending rather than inferred.

provenance.note: Repository searches found no WPFW Two Bass Hit September 13 representation before publication. Core performance and pricing facts come from WPFW's own event page. en.why_it_matters: The useful hook is not simply another Sunday jazz set: WPFW has built Two Bass Hit around a Washington/Baltimore bass conversation, with Herman Burney beside Reginald Cyntje and Kris Funn bringing back his DC JazzPrix-winning CornerStore group, all under a Ray Brown nod and the station's 50th-year benefit series. It is a compact piece of DMV jazz ecology — two cities, two bass voices and the community station that has documented this scene for decades.
en.trip_verdict: If Sunday afternoon is open in DC, this is worth the short local detour to Palisades Hub. It is a good piece of DMV context to catch when convenient rather than a reason to reshape a regional trip.
